name: loop, wrap forward after crossing the start

steps.why: On the final 500 m side, the fix is 20 m before the start: 2000 − 20 = 1980 m.
The next fix is 20 m onto the first side, across the loop start; forward progress wraps from 1980 m to the next lap at 20 m.
The point is 100 m from the start on this lap; 100 − 20 = 80 m forward.
